# Task: Advanced Certification Learning Path with Complex Prerequisites
## Objective Create a Strategic Certification chapter in the Professional Learning Roadmap with sophisticated prerequisite chains. Replace the usual final notes section with a small mentor relation setup that can be verified automatically.
## Requirements
### 1. Create Strategic Certification Chapter - Database: Chapters database - Properties:
  - Name: Strategic Certification
  - Icon: 🟣 (purple circle emoji)
  - Must appear after Advanced Practice in the database

### 2. Create Bridge Lesson Create a lesson that bridges advanced and strategic certification content: - Title: Certification Readiness Review - Status: Done - Chapter: Link to Strategic Certification - Parent item: Link to the lesson that currently has status In Progress
  and contains "Portfolio" in its title
- Sub-items: Must link to exactly these three lessons:
  - The lesson with title containing "Stakeholder Mapping"
  - The lesson with title containing "Risk Review"
  - The lesson with title containing "Executive Narrative"

### 3. Create Strategic Certification Lessons Add exactly 4 strategic lessons to the Steps database:
**Lesson 1**: Certification Portfolio Architecture - Status: To Do - Chapter: Strategic Certification - Parent item: Link to Certification Readiness Review - Date: 2025-08-11
**Lesson 2**: Mentor-Led Mock Review - Status: To Do - Chapter: Strategic Certification - Parent item: Link to the lesson titled Risk Review - Date: 2025-08-18
**Lesson 3**: Executive Case Study Defense - Status: In Progress - Chapter: Strategic Certification - Parent item: Link to Certification Readiness Review - Sub-item: Must have exactly 2 links:
  - Link to any lesson from Foundations that has status To Do
  - Link to the lesson containing "Presentation" in its title
- Date: 2025-08-25
**Lesson 4**: Certification Submission Package - Status: To Do - Chapter: Strategic Certification - Parent item: Link to Certification Portfolio Architecture - Date: 2025-09-01
### 4. Update Existing Lessons - Change the status of "Stakeholder Mapping" from To Do to Done - Add "Mentor-Led Mock Review" as a Sub-item to "Communication Planning" - Update "Portfolio Strategy" status from In Progress to Done
### 5. Connect Certifications and Mentors Replace the usual Learning Path Notes section with this relation setup: - In the Certifications database, add a relation property named Supporting
  Mentors that points to the Mentors database.
- Ensure the relation is bidirectional by adding Supported Certifications in
  Mentors.
- Create exactly two mentor pages, Mira Chen and Rafael Ortiz, set Status to
  Available, and link each mentor to at least one Strategic Certification
  lesson or certification record.
